categories.main_business_segments: Keihanshin Building Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the real estate leasing business, focusing on the rental of office buildings, data center buildings, 'WINS' off-track betting facilities, commercial facilities, and logistics warehouses. The company also provides building management services, including maintenance and cleaning. All operations are reported as a single business segment: real estate leasing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core operational methods involve direct ownership and leasing of commercial real estate, as well as subleasing properties rented from other owners. Building management emphasizes regular maintenance, equipment upgrades (such as LED lighting and energy-efficient HVAC), and disaster resilience (including seismic isolation and flood prevention). For data centers, advanced security, stable power supply, and 24/7 operations are key features.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large corporations and institutions requiring office space, data center operators (notably Equinix Japan and SoftBank), and the Japan Racing Association (JRA) for WINS facilities. The company serves a diversified tenant base across office, data center, commercial, and logistics sectors, with a notable concentration of revenue from a few major clients.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are concentrated in the Kansai region, especially Osaka (accounting for nearly 79% of rental revenue), with additional properties in Hyogo, Kyoto, the Tokyo metropolitan area (about 15%), and recent expansion into Aichi Prefecture and the United States. The majority of assets and revenue remain domestically focused, but overseas investment is increasing.
categories.supply_chain_position: Keihanshin Building operates downstream in the real estate value chain, directly providing end-users (tenants) with rental space and related building management services. The company acts as a landlord and facility manager, interfacing directly with corporate and institutional tenants.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding the asset portfolio through new investments in prime office, logistics, and data center properties, diversifying asset types (including residential and healthcare), and increasing overseas and equity investments. The company is also focused on ESG initiatives, such as reducing GHG emissions, increasing green building certifications, and promoting diversity and human capital development. Digital transformation (DX) and disaster resilience are also emphasized.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through long-term leasing of owned and subleased properties, with additional income from building management services. The company also earns from equity investments and occasional asset sales, but the core model is stable, contract-based rental income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include other Japanese real estate leasing and development firms, particularly those with a strong presence in the Kansai and Tokyo regions. Keihanshin Building is positioned as a mid-sized, financially stable player with a focus on high-occupancy, high-quality assets and long-term tenant relationships, differentiating itself through its data center expertise and ESG initiatives.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of March 2025, consolidated revenue was approximately 19.6 billion yen, with total assets of 177.1 billion yen and net assets of 76.3 billion yen. The company has maintained steady revenue growth (1.4% YoY), high occupancy rates, and stable profitability, with a long-term plan targeting significant asset and profit growth by 2033. The workforce is small (64 employees), reflecting a lean operational model.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Keihanshin Building emphasizes the provision of safe, high-quality, and resilient business environments, particularly in office and data center spaces. Its value proposition includes high occupancy rates, advanced disaster and energy management, strong ESG performance (including green building certifications), and long-term, trust-based tenant relationships. The company also highlights its adaptability to market changes and commitment to sustainable growth.
